conventions.position: effective position 0–71; 19–38 = core pass 1, 39–58 = the same weights on pass 2 (pass-2 position = pass-1 + 20)
conventions.dose: units of the median norm entering that position's FFN; 0.5–0.8 shows a direction coherently, 1.5+ often loops
conventions.pole: the sign that carries the concept: steer with +dose for '+', −dose for '−'
conventions.confidence: none = firing, steering and controls agree; (?) one view weak or untested; (??) one view only; (???) views disagree
conventions.steer_positions: the position(s) where steering is the lever, read from the steer notes; 'positions' lists where the neuron fires (both passes of one module for core neurons), which is not where it steers. Empty = not a clean lever
